::: {.home-intro}

I am a spatial data scientist and public health professional working at the intersection of geographic information systems, mosquito control, remote sensing, and field operations.

I build geospatial tools and analytical workflows that connect surveillance, remote sensing, and field operations. My work helps organizations transform complex data to clear, defensible actions.

I currently lead technical development at Collier Mosquito Control District, where I work across GIS, spatial analytics, unmanned aircraft systems, and operational mosquito control.

## Selected work

::: {.home-work-grid}

::: {.work-feature .work-feature-kde}
<div class="work-feature-index" aria-hidden="true">01</div>

### Mosquito Complaint Hotspot Analysis

A year-by-year view of where 28,889 resident mosquito complaints concentrated across Collier County from 2020 through 2026. A consistent 1,500-meter kernel density surface and fixed scale make patterns comparable while keeping complaint intensity distinct from mosquito abundance.

<p class="work-feature-meta">Kernel density estimation <span>·</span> R <span>·</span> sf <span>·</span> Leaflet</p>

[Explore the interactive analysis](https://atom-geo.github.io/sr_kde_collier/){.work-feature-link}
:::

::: {.work-feature .work-feature-asap}
<div class="work-feature-index" aria-hidden="true">02</div>

### Aerial Swath Analysis Platform (ASAP)

A guided web application for processing and visualizing granular aerial-application calibration data. ASAP evaluates application rate, granular density, swath uniformity, and overlap so operational teams can identify clear, reproducible calibration parameters.

<p class="work-feature-meta">Granular applications <span>·</span> Swath modeling <span>·</span> Calibration</p>

::: {.work-feature-links}
[Launch the live application](https://atom-sds-asap.share.connect.posit.cloud/){.work-feature-link}

[View the source repository](https://github.com/atom-rosales/ASAP){.work-feature-link}

[Read the published article](https://jamca.kglmeridian.com/view/journals/moco/42/3/article-p237.xml){.work-feature-link}
:::
